entities.name: Luminița Odobescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luminița-Teodora Odobescu is a Romanian career diplomat. She serves as Presidential Adviser for the interim President of Romania, starting 13 February 2025. Between January and February 2025, she held the position of State Adviser for Foreign Policy and Security within the Chancellery of the Prime Minister.

entities.summary: Luminița-Teodora Odobescu is a Romanian career diplomat. She serves as Presidential Adviser for the interim President of Romania, starting 13 February 2025. Between January and February 2025, she held the position of State Adviser for Foreign Policy and Security within the Chancellery of the Prime Minister.
